items.description: A table definition, or a conformed reference (it carries `conformed_from`, no columns). Both are closed, so exactly one matches.
A table definition, or a conformed reference (it carries `conformed_from`, no columns). Both are closed, so exactly one matches.

timezone.description: IANA time zone of the business calendar, e.g. Europe/Berlin.

fiscal_year_start.description: First day of the fiscal year as MM-DD.

storage_mode.description: Partition mode for all tables in this contract. Import = M/Power Query partitions (local parquet). DirectLake = entity partitions pointing to Fabric Lakehouse Delta tables.

lakehouse_id.description: Fabric Lakehouse item GUID. Required when storage_mode = DirectLake. Used to build the DL_Lakehouse named expression in expressions.tmdl.

workspace_id.description: Fabric Workspace GUID. Required when storage_mode = DirectLake.

showcase.description: false = the Aurora showcase has no data for this table (missing = present).
false = the Aurora showcase has no data for this table (missing = present).

qa.description: Prose QA notes that do not structure (the machine-run rules live in column `checks`).

role.description: `key` marks the surrogate key of a dimension (FK target of `ref`).

ref.description: FK: name of the referenced dimension (its `role: key` column).

nullable.description: true = NULL allowed. Missing = never NULL.

agg.description: Default aggregation of a measure column (sum, avg, max ...).

cardinality.description: Relationship cardinality of an FK column, e.g. many-to-one.

allowed_values.description: Enumerated domain of values — grounds NL -> column-value mapping and the column `Values:` projection.

synonyms.description: Curated natural-language synonyms — projected into the model linguistic schema (cultures/linguisticMetadata) for Copilot/Q&A and into the `///` Synonyms facet.

source_column.description: Physical Gold column when `name` is the business/model name (TMDL column + sourceColumn split). Must differ from `name` (checked by check_validate_data_contracts.py).

unknown_member.description: FK only: never NULL; the value (e.g. -1) is the placeholder row of the referenced dimension. Requires `ref`; `nullable` must not be true (checked by check_validate_data_contracts.py).

target_state.description: Target design: not (yet) delivered by the Aurora showcase or read by a model.

check_entry.description: Exactly one rule key out of gte, gt, lte, lt, between, in, gte_column, lte_column; optionally when_present: true. Semantics: core/data_contracts/domains/README.md.

gte_column.description: Another column of the same table.

lte_column.description: Another column of the same table.

check_entry.$comment: Exactly one rule key: every other key is a rule key, so the count of keys decides (with when_present two, else one).

quality_rules.description: What does not structure (A-20/A-23): freshness and prose rules. Not-null, FK, unknown member and value ranges live on the columns (nullable, ref, unknown_member, checks).

freshness_sla.description: One cadence for the contract, or one per table.

conformed_reference.description: Conformed reference (Bus-Matrix, 29.09.2026): the table is defined once, in the owning domain named by conformed_from; this domain only uses it. No columns, no own table fields.

conformed_from.description: Owning domain (its `domain:` value) that holds the only definition.

uses_columns.description: Columns of the definition this domain's model uses (domain view); default all.
